articles.summary: SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO, Calif., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Ensign Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENSG), which invests in facilities that provide skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies, and other rehabilitative and healthcare services, today announced that 101 of its independently operating affiliates have been recognized and included in the listing of the 2027 Best Nursing Homes by U.S. News World Report. Since 2009, U.S. News’ annual Best Nursing Homes analysis has served as an independent, data-driven guide for families navigating short-term rehabilitation or comprehensive long-term care choices. Each Ensign-affiliated facility on the list earned a High Performing rating – the highest distinction awarded by U.S. News – reflecting outstanding quality in Short-Term Rehabilitation, Long-Term Care, or both. articles.title: U.S. News & World Report Names Over 100 Independently Operating Ensign Group Affiliates Among Best Nursing Homes for 2027

articles.summary: SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Ensign Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENSG), the parent company of the Ensign TM group of companies, which invest in and provide skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies, other rehabilitative and healthcare services, and real estate, announced today that it will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 18, 2026. Barry Port, Chief Executive Officer, and Chad Keetch, Chief Investment Officer, will review the company's operations, growth strategy and related information at 11:45 a.m. Central Time on November 18, 2026. A live audio webcast of the presentation will be accessible via website at https://event.summitcast.com/view/AnJcL7fjsXraGqV8XG6fRL/er5VJpQaEUBEqX7cT93t3m . The webcast will be recorded and will be available for replay via the website for 90 days following the presentation. About Ensign TM The Ensign Group, Inc.'s independent subsidiaries
